description: Checks an OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 document (as JSON): version, info, paths, responses, unique operationIds, declared path parameters and unresolved local $refs. Returns { valid, version, operations, refs, unresolvedRefs, errors: [{ path, message }], warnings: [{ path, message }] } Price: 2 credits (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

spec.description: The OpenAPI document as a JSON object (convert YAML first). Request bodies are capped at 64 KiB.
